artworks.title: Trempealeau, Wis.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image is a cyanotype photograph featuring a view across a calm river towards a small town. The buildings extend along the water's edge, with a hill and lush greenery in the background. The river flows to the left, disappearing into the horizon, which becomes more narrow and indistinct. Trees on the right add depth to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic blue, typical of cyanotypes, giving the scene a serene and ethereal visual impact.

artworks.title: Dakota, Minn.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a low vantage point looking across a body of water towards the opposite shore. The horizon is in the middle of the view, with a small townscape featuring buildings and a prominent steeple above the tree line. Trees on both sides frame the scene, with clusters in the middle and towards the edges. The image is a cyanotype, giving it blue tones. The water nearby reflects the sky subtly. Various shades of blue create depth and detail, with rolling hills in the distance against the lighter sky.

artworks.title: Levee at La Crosse, Wis.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a view across a body of water towards a busy industrial area on the opposite shore. The horizon line is situated about one third from the top, where the water meets the shore. An urban landscape stretches across the scene, with a bridge extending from the left towards the distant buildings on the right. The photo is in a cyanotype style, with blue and white tones creating a monochromatic effect. The color palette ranges from lighter blues on the water's surface to darker hues merging with the sky at the top. The buildings in the distance, including smokestacks and various structures, contrast sharply with the blurred water in the foreground.

artworks.title: Bad Axe, Wis.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a wide river cutting through the landscape, with a rocky shoreline extending into the distance. Along the shoreline, there are a few buildings and telephone poles scattered. In the background, low, rolling hills rise to meet the sky. The image has a monochromatic cyanotype palette, casting everything in shades of blue. The brushstrokes of waves along the river are smooth, creating a tranquil scene.

artworks.title: Crooked Slough
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a river flowing through a landscape with trees and small landmasses. The horizon is high in the frame, with the river narrowing in the distance. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic blue cyanotype style, with leafy branches framing the edges. The river's surface reflects light against the trees on the banks. The overall atmosphere is serene, with various blue shades blending land and water forms.

artworks.title: S. McGregor, Ia.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene with a town nestled between hills. The riverbank is in the foreground, with the town in the distance framed by two forested hills. There is a branch partially submerged in the calm water. The image is in a monochromatic blue palette, giving it a serene tone.

artworks.title: Savanna, Ill.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image depicts a view overlooking a large expanse of water occupying the lower half of the circular frame. The horizon line is placed in the upper third of the circle, where the water meets distant land. Beyond the water, there is a hillscape with small buildings, trees, and a tall structure near the center-right of the image. The color palette is monochromatic blue, resembling cyanotypes. The scene evokes a cool, serene atmosphere. The sky above the horizon shows soft, muted cloud formations drifting across a light blue expanse.

artworks.title: Guard Rock, Des Moines Rapids Canal L.W.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a canal lock system near a body of water. The horizon line is high, with a treeline visible across the water. A grassy slope with a wooden fence is in the foreground, leading to buildings and a canal lock with a guardhouse. The cyanotype style gives a blue-tinted color palette, ranging from deep blues to lighter shades. The water reflects light, adding to the serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Ponton Bridge at Read's Landing, Minn.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows a water landscape with a high horizon, an elongated bridge, an island with dense vegetation, and a shoreline with plants and shrubs. The cyanotype style gives the image a blue tint. Closest to us is the shoreline, with the water beyond. In the distance, hills rise on the right side and fade into the sky.

artworks.title: C.M. & St. P. RR Bridge at Sabula, Ia.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy S. Aubrey and E. Steve Lichtenberg, MD
artworks.description: The image shows railway tracks extending towards a bridge over water. The bridge is made of metal trusses with stone piers below, and two tall towers are visible at its ends. Beside the tracks, there are grassy patches and a leafless tree. The sky is prominent, with the bridge dividing it from the lower half of the image. The overall color scheme is in shades of blue.

artworks.title: Maternal Love
artworks.medium: etching with monotype inking on chine collé
artworks.description: The image is an artwork depicting a close-up of two faces, that of a woman and a child, within a circular frame. The woman is in a side profile, leaning forward to touch her nose to the child's, with her arms gently holding the child close. Both have soft, delicate features. The woman's hair appears styled around her face, blending into the background, while the child has short, curly hair. The sketch does not distinctly show clothing but focuses mainly on the contact between the two faces. Below the circular frame, a detailed illustration of flowers lies across the bottom of the image. The background outside the circle is abstract and textured.

artworks.title: Ruit Hora (Fleeting Time)
artworks.description: In the center of this print, there is a large, detailed skull set against a circular backdrop resembling a clock face, with numbers ranging from 1 to 12. The skull dominates the composition, with hollow eye sockets and a half-open mouth. Outside of the circle of the clock, there is a sun drawn in the top left corner of the image and a moon in the top right. Several six-pointed stars are positioned near the bottom corners. The color palette is shades of gray on the off-white paper.

artworks.title: Oxen Yoked to a Cart (Maremma) (Bovi al carro (Maremma))
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper [artist's proof (?), before reduction of the plate (?)]
artworks.description: The image shows an eye-level view of an open field. The horizon is low, with distant trees and a structure that resembles a house in the background. A wooden cart with a thatched covering is being pulled by two oxen, accompanied by a dog nearby. Further back, a horse stands alone in the field. The background features swirling lines indicative of movement in the sky. The image is a detailed black and white etching, with fine linework creating textures, particularly in the clouds and the fur of the animals. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on white paper emphasizing contrast and detail.

artworks.title: Woman of the Gabbro (Donna al gabbro)
artworks.description: The image features a person viewed from the back. The individual is standing with one hand on their hip and the other hand hanging by their side, looking towards a village in the distance. The person's face is not visible as it is turned away, with their hair covered by a headscarf tied at the nape. They are wearing a long dress with a fitted bodice, long sleeves, and a cinched waist, along with detailed designs on the bodice and shoulders. The background shows a rural landscape with rolling hills, scattered vegetation, rustic buildings, and a clear sky.

artworks.title: Holy Cow (Pio bove)
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horned animal in a grassy field. In the background, there is a large structure resembling a haystack with a tall spike at its peak. Rolling hills extend into the distance, under a sky with swirling clouds. The depiction uses detailed etching to show texture in the grass, clouds, and hills. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black lines on a white background.

artworks.title: House of Dante da Castiglione [Casa di Dante da Castiglione]
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow urban alley with buildings on either side, drawing the viewer's eye into the scene. The buildings converge at the end of the alley, suggesting depth. The artwork uses etching techniques with intricate lines to depict the buildings. A person is walking in the foreground, and another figure is partially hidden in a doorway on the right. The color palette is primarily black and white, emphasizing high contrast. Light and shadow create a chiaroscuro effect, highlighting the architectural forms and figures.

artworks.title: Santa Maria della Tromba
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level view of an urban alleyway between tall buildings. The rooftops of the buildings frame the sky. The surfaces have a textured appearance with shadows and architectural details. The color scheme is monochrome with shades of black and gray. Near the viewer, there is a crowd of people, while the scene becomes quieter in the distance where a street lamp is visible.

artworks.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: etching, sulfur tint, and roulette printed in brown
artworks.description: The image features two individuals seated outdoors on rocky terrain, engaged in conversation or contemplation. Both figures are captured from at least the waist up. The person on the left has soft facial features and curly hair, while the individual on the right has more expressive hair and beard. They are both clothed in draped garments. The setting includes expressive trees with sweeping branches and a landscape with hills or a distant view. The artwork is bordered.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child with Two Angels
artworks.medium: etching, sulfur tint, and roulette printed in red on on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows a woman seated, holding an infant in her lap, with two cherubic figures standing beside her. The woman's head is slightly bowed, her eyes cast downward, and her hair styled with a halo above her head. She is draped in flowing robes, seated on a stone structure. The infant is nestled against her chest, and the cherubic figures stand beside her, one touching the drapery. The background includes a large vertical column and draped fabric, suggesting an indoor setting. The artwork is monochromatic, rendered in shades of sepia.

artworks.title: Flagellation of a Saint
artworks.artist: Andrea Scacciati after Giovanni Battista Paggi
artworks.medium: etching, sulfur tint, and roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of muscular figures. The central figure is partially draped with bound hands, surrounded by other figures. Two cherubic figures with wings hover above them. Light falls on the scene through a window or aperture. Stairs and architectural elements are present, creating a sense of depth and movement. Detailed linework and shading depict the characters.

artworks.title: Christ Consigning the Keys to Saint Peter
artworks.artist: Andrea Scacciati, after Jacopo da Empoli
artworks.medium: etching, sulfur tint, and roulette printed in green on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures near a palm tree. The central figure is conversing with another figure who is kneeling. Other figures are surrounding them. The background shows cloudy skies and a tall palm tree. The figures are dressed in flowing robes, with detailed folds in the fabric. Shading is used to give dimension to the drawing, creating a lifelike appearance.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.medium: etching, sulfur tint, and roulette printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows four men interacting. The central figure is seated with crossed legs, wavy hair, a beard, and a loose robe. The other three men are positioned around him, one standing behind and two crouched on either side, each holding a stick towards his head. They have short, curly hair, wear tunic-style clothing, and are barefoot. In the background is an architectural element resembling a doorway or frame with a triangular pediment on top.

artworks.title: Carica di cavalleria (Calvary Charge)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a cavalry charge on a battlefield, done in the style of Giovanni Fattori. The scene is depicted in shades of black and white, showing horses and soldiers in motion. The horses are shown in dynamic poses, with flowing manes and kicking hooves. The soldiers are in uniform, holding rifles as they charge. The landscape is textured with grass and shrubbery, adding to the sense of movement and tension. The composition emphasizes the drama and intensity of the moment, capturing the tumultuous nature of cavalry battles.

artworks.title: Via de' Cavalieri
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow alleyway with tall buildings on both sides. There is an archway in the center leading into the distance. A lamp hangs above the archway. The stone walls have a textured surface. The perspective is downward, and the alley turns slightly out of view. The etching is detailed with cross-hatching creating depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown.
